name: Trentino-South Tyrol
summary: White over blue with the regional arms: a quartered shield with the eagle of Saint Wenceslas of Trentino in the 1st and 4th quarters and the red Tyrolean eagle of South Tyrol in the 2nd and 3rd.
origin: The white and blue flag has been used in a limited way since 1995 but has never been legally defined. The arms were approved in 1982–83. The eagle of Saint Wenceslas was granted to Trento by John of Luxembourg on 9 August 1339.

colors.name: White
colors.meaning: The historical field of Trento's arms.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: The historical field of Bolzano's arms.

symbols.name: Eagle of Saint Wenceslas
symbols.description: A black eagle with red flames.

facts: The region is made up of two autonomous provinces with their own flags.
German is the majority language in South Tyrol.
clues: White over blue with a shield of four eagles.
A region of two autonomous provinces.
